fields.summary: Grit — Android Habit Tracker & Todo App (Habitly POC)

content.text: 1. Executive Summary

Grit is a free, open-source Android productivity app that combines a daily habit tracker with a categorized todo list in one clean, Material You interface. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose Multiplatform, targeting users who want a single lightweight app to manage both recurring habits and one-off tasks without subscriptions, ads, or artificial limits. Distributed under GPLv3 across Google Play, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, and GitHub.
2. Problem Statement
Habit trackers do not handle one-off tasks, leaving users dependent on a second app
Todo apps do not show habit streaks or heatmaps, key drivers of long-term behavior change
Many polished apps are paywalled with free tiers deliberately limited to drive upgrades
Open-source alternatives often have dated UI — Material You and Expressive Motion are rare
3. Goals & KPIs
Provide a single unified productivity app covering both habits and tasks
Deliver polished Material You design with Expressive Motion animations
Keep all features free — no IAP, no ads, no arbitrary limits
Target Month 3: >1,500 GitHub stars, >4.3 Play rating, >35% Day-7 retention, >5,000 F-Droid installs
Target Month 12: >3,000 GitHub stars, >4.5 Play rating, >45% Day-7 retention, >25,000 F-Droid installs
4. Feature Requirements
Habit Tracker Module
F-01 (P0) Habit Creation & Scheduling — title, description, reminder time, active days (DayOfWeek). Serializable model for backup/restore.
F-02 (P0) Daily Check-In — Habits List shows today's applicable habits. Tap to mark complete. HabitStatus record stored per date + habitId.
F-03 (P0) Streak Tracking — current streak, best streak, StreakPosition enum. Missed applicable day resets streak.
F-04 (P0) Habit Analytics — consistency score, weekly comparison chart (1yr history), monthly calendar heatmap (GitHub-style), OverallAnalytics aggregation.
F-05 (P0) Habit Reminders — daily recurring notifications. Quick check-in from notification action button. Toggle per habit.
Todo / Task Module
F-06 (P0) Task Categories — named, colored, reorderable groups. Drag-and-drop via Compose Reorderable.
F-07 (P0) Task Management — title, completion status, display order, drag-to-reorder within categories.
F-08 (P1) Task Reminders — one-time datetime reminders for deadline-style tasks (LocalDateTime).
Settings & Customization
F-09 (P1) Material You Dynamic Theming — wallpaper palette on Android 12+; custom color picker for older versions.
F-10 (P1) Localization — Weblate translations, in-app language picker (Android 13+), RTL layout support.
F-11 (P0) Home Screen Widgets — Jetpack Glance widgets showing today's habits. Tap to complete without opening app.
F-12 (P1) Backup & Restore — export/import all habit, task, category, and status data. User-selectable export location.
5. Technical Architecture
UI: Jetpack Compose Multiplatform (Android + WASM web demo)
Persistence: Room (Android) + SQLDelight pattern with schema versioning
DI: Koin + Koin Annotations with KSP compile-time validation
Async: Kotlin Coroutines + Flow for reactive repository layer
Widgets: Jetpack Glance (androidx.glance.appwidget)
Architecture: Clean Architecture + MVI-inspired presentation, domain-driven feature structure
Multiplatform: KMP shared business logic between Android and WASM web demo
6. Key Data Models
Habit — id, title, description, time (LocalDateTime), days (Set of DayOfWeek), index, reminder (Boolean)
HabitStatus — ties habit completion to a specific LocalDate
OverallAnalytics — heatMapData (Map of LocalDate to Int), weekDayFrequencyData, consistency (Float 0-1), topHabits
Task — id, categoryId, title, index, status (Boolean), reminder (LocalDateTime nullable)
Category — id, name, index, color (String, reserved for future use)
7. Constraints & Out of Scope
GPLv3 license — any derivative must also be GPLv3
No cloud sync — data is local only; backup/restore is the only cross-device mechanism (intentional for privacy)
No monetization — no IAP, no ads, no subscription
Android primary target — iOS not supported; WASM web demo is a showcase only
Out of scope: iOS native app, cloud sync, social features, paid tier, Wear OS, category color in UI
8. Risks & Mitigations
Risk (Medium): No cloud sync causes data loss on device reset. Mitigation: improve backup UX; consider auto-backup to Google Drive in v2.
Risk (Medium): Android OS changes break Glance widget rendering. Mitigation: abstract widget data access; monitor Glance release notes.
Risk (High): Solo maintainer bandwidth limits issue resolution. Mitigation: recruit co-maintainers via GitHub Discussions; label good first issues.
Risk (Medium): Weblate translations become stale for minority languages. Mitigation: automate staleness detection; prune inactive locales.
9. Roadmap
Social progress sharing — shareable cards showing habit streaks and consistency stats
Category color usage — render colored category chips and section headers
Expanded multiplatform — KMP foundation laid for desktop or full iOS support
10. References

Web Demo: shub39.github.io/Grit
